title: The fixed coefficient scalar realization data
statement: For commutative condensed coefficient rings R,S and a ring-object map a with exact internal extension, retain the section ring map, the canonical left-derived scalar/pullback path comparison, the actual geometric tensor comparison, the sheafified scalar pure generator, the exact internal scalar complex comparison, and the signed total of an ordinary scalar tensorator. CoefficientScalarSectionRealization(a,Z) asserts the normalized ordinary and derived scalar adjunction identifications, pure-generator formula, signed flat-term K-flat representative square, and compatibility with the actual internal scalar tensorator. These are exactly the existing constructions formerly in lem-sfb-coefficient-scalar-tensor-realization, with no changed formulas or hypotheses.
